reason: The plan shows only the phase IV mud-brick houses 171 and 172 in the south-western corner of Block 'B' of the Acropolis, an area about 11 x 8 m, framed by the grid pegs E3, D3, C3, B3, E4 and E5. No drawn feature can be found in the image: the walls are below the 0.55 m resolution of the imagery (zoom 19 is not available here), and Block 'B' cannot be placed within the Acropolis because the site plan with the excavation grid (Plate IV) is missing from the available scan and the other plans in the volume do not show the grid. No auxiliary plan links these pegs to surviving features.
